kitEvidence.formula:
Xin Zhao slashes, dealing [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage, then thrusts, dealing [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.9) × AD + (0.65) × AP) × ((1 + (0.333) × Stat(8)))]. Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by [50]% for [1.5 + (0.005) × AP] seconds. 

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for [3] seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.

builds.name: Crescent Guard: hybrid current-health sweep
builds.summary: Investigate high one Crescent Guard sweep output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Crescent Guard sweep output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R deals 75/175/275 + 1.0 bonus AD + 1.1 AP physical plus 15% of enemy current HP. AP has a larger displayed coefficient than bonus AD, while armor still mitigates the packet. The protective zone and knockback are utility, not additional damage.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for [3] seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals [75 / 175 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.1) × AP] plus [15]% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies. 
  
Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for [4] seconds.
